item.title: Qatar and US sign AI partnership at eighth Strategic Dialogue
item.description:
Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al-Thani and US Secretary of State Marco Rubio co-chaired the eighth Qatar-US Strategic Dialogue in Washington on Monday. The two sides signed an artificial intelligence acceleration partnership and a memorandum of understanding on critical minerals processing. The dialogue covered the defence partnership, freedom of maritime navigation, cooperation opportunities in Latin America and efforts to de-escalate regional tensions.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/24/prime-minister-and-minister-of-foreign-affairs-us-secretary-of-state-chair-8th-qatar-us-strategic-dialogue · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266187/latest-news/qatar-and-us-strengthen-bilateral-partnership-at-eighth-strategic-dialogue-in-washington · Al Raya (QNA, Al Jazeera Net) https://www.raya.com/2026/11/24/رئيس-الوزراء-تعزيز-الشراكة-الاستراتيجية-مع-أمريكا

item.title: Prime Minister says Qatar seeks to revive Iran-US negotiations
item.description:
Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al-Thani said on Monday the Middle East cannot bear a new escalation between the United States and Iran, and that Qatar is working with both sides to revive negotiations. He told Al Jazeera diplomacy must be the only option for the two parties. Rubio said Washington values Qatar’s mediation and stressed continued coordination with Doha to deter threats.
Sources: Al Sharq https://al-sharq.com/article/23/11/2026/رئيس-الوزراء-نسعى-لإحياء-المسار-التفاوضي-بين-إيران-وأمريكا-والوضع-لا-يحتمل-التصعيد · Al Sharq https://al-sharq.com/article/24/11/2026/وزير-الخارجية-الأمريكي-نقدر-جهود-الوساطة-القطرية · Al Raya (QNA, Al Jazeera Net) https://www.raya.com/2026/11/24/رئيس-الوزراء-تعزيز-الشراكة-الاستراتيجية-مع-أمريكا · Gulf News (AFP) https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/trump-threatens-to-sink-iranian-vessels-as-us-strikes-oil-tanker-ghalibaf-calls-for-lasting-security-1.500757421

item.title: Prime Minister and Abdelatty discuss regional de-escalation efforts
item.description:
Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al-Thani discussed bilateral relations and regional developments with Egyptian Foreign Minister Dr Badr Abdelatty by phone on Monday. The call covered ways to strengthen Qatar-Egypt ties and joint diplomatic coordination to de-escalate tensions and promote security and stability. The prime minister reaffirmed Qatar’s support for all diplomatic initiatives.
Sources: The Peninsula (QNA) https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/23/11/2026/prime-minister-discusses-bilateral-relations-region-with-egypt-fm · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/266004/latest-news/prime-minister-egyptian-fm-discuss-joint-efforts-to-de-escalate-tensions · Al Sharq https://al-sharq.com/article/23/11/2026/اتصال-هاتفي-بين-رئيس-مجلس-الوزراء-وزير-الخارجية-ووزير-الخارجية-المصري-2

item.title: Finance Minister discusses investment cooperation with Canadian counterpart
item.description:
Minister of Finance Ali bin Ahmed Al Kuwari met Canada’s Minister of Finance and National Revenue Francois-Philippe Champagne in Doha during his visit. The two sides reviewed bilateral relations, potential areas of cooperation and economic, investment and trade developments.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/24/minister-of-finance-meets-canadas-minister-of-finance-national-revenue · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/24/11/2026/minister-of-finance-meets-canadas-minister-of-finance-national-revenue

item.title: Qatar Airways launches discounts of up to 25% until 30 November
item.description:
Qatar Airways launched its Black Friday offers with discounts of up to 25% on fares to more than 170 destinations. Bookings are open from 23 to 30 November 2026 for travel until 30 October 2027, with one free date change on eligible bookings, though fare differences may apply.
Sources: Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/24/القطرية-تطلق-خصومات-تصل-إلى-25 · Al Sharq https://al-sharq.com/article/23/11/2026/بخصم-25-للسفر-حتى-30-أكتوبر-2027-تفاصيل-عرض-القطرية-للجمعة-المميزة

item.title: Doha Zoo to reopen to visitors in third quarter of 2027
item.description:
Minister of Municipality Abdullah bin Hamad bin Abdullah Al Attiyah on Monday inspected the Doha Zoo rehabilitation project ahead of its planned reopening in the third quarter of 2027. The project upgrades facilities and services while preserving the zoo’s identity, restoring it as a family destination for leisure, learning and discovering wildlife.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/23/11/2026/doha-zoo-to-welcome-visitors-again-in-q3-2027 · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265992/latest-news/doha-zoo-set-to-reopen-in-third-quarter-of-2027-following-rehabilitation · Al Sharq https://al-sharq.com/article/23/11/2026/حديقة-الحيوان-بالدوحة-تستعد-لاستقبال-زوارها-من-جديد-في-هذا-الموعد

item.title: Al Arabi beat Oman Club 26-20 to boost Gulf Handball Cup hopes
item.description:
Defending champions Al Arabi beat Oman Club 26-20 on Monday evening in the third round of the 42nd Gulf Handball Clubs Cup in Bahrain, moving to 5 points unbeaten. Al Rayyan lost to Bahrain’s Al Ahli and remain on one point. Al Arabi face Kuwait’s Burgan in the fourth round on Tuesday, and the top four advance to the semifinals on 29 November.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/24/gulf-handball-championship-al-arabi-beat-omans-oman-sc-al-rayyan-lose-to-bahrains-al-ahli · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/24/العربي-يواصل-انتصاراته-باليد-الخليجية

item.title: Israel approves return of flydubai flights pending security clearance
item.description:
Israeli Transport Minister Miri Regev on Monday approved the resumption of flydubai flights, subject to final approval by security authorities. The flights had been halted after a co-pilot tried to crash one of the airline’s planes in September. The ministry described the move as a significant renewal of air connectivity between Israel and the UAE.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/israeli-minister-approves-return-of-flydubai-flights · Gulf News (AFP) https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/trump-threatens-to-sink-iranian-vessels-as-us-strikes-oil-tanker-ghalibaf-calls-for-lasting-security-1.500757421

item.title: UAE President and Al Shara discuss expanding economic ties by phone
item.description:
UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan and Syrian President Ahmad Al Shara discussed bilateral relations, especially economic and development cooperation, in a phone call on Monday. The two leaders also reviewed regional developments and efforts to address them.
Sources: The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/uae/2026/11/23/president-sheikh-mohamed-speaks-with-syrian-leader-ahmad-al-shara/ · Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/23/uae-syrian-presidents-discuss-mideastern-updates-over-phone

item.title: Beyond Developments unveils Dh80 billion Yardlands project in Dubai
item.description:
Beyond Developments, part of Omniyat Group, on Monday unveiled Yardlands on Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Road in Dubai, a Dh80 billion ($22 billion) project. It will include 25,000 homes on about 19 million square feet, is expected to host 300,000 residents and visitors annually, and is due for completion by 2040.
Sources: The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/property/2026/11/23/yardlands-dubai-sheikh-mohamed-bin-zayed-road/ · Khaleej Times https://www.khaleejtimes.com/business/dubais-new-city-within-a-city-dh80-billion-yardlands-to-house-300000-residents-2

item.title: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry names 2026-2030 board
item.description:
The Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry’s election committee on Monday evening announced the winners of seats on the chamber’s board and its governorate branch boards for 2026-2030. The committee was chaired by Eng. Ghalib bin Said Al Maamari, Undersecretary of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion, and voter turnout was modest.
Sources: Oman Observer https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1200152/oman/occi-elects-new-board-of-directors-with-modest-voter-turnout · Times of Oman https://www.timesofoman.com/article/179527-occi-announces-winners-of-20262030-board-elections-across-all-governorates

item.title: Brent settles below $90, lowest since August
item.description:
Oil prices fell more than 3% at settlement on Monday, with Brent down 3.46% at $89.37 a barrel and West Texas Intermediate at $80.17, according to Reuters. Brent posted its lowest settlement since 31 August as Middle East supplies increased and crude resumed flowing through Libya’s Sharara field pipeline.
Sources: Cairo 24 (Reuters) https://www.cairo24.com/2534808 · Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/24/oil-prices-fall-more-than-3-percent-at-settlement

item.title: Al Ahly part ways with Hussein Amouta after Pyramids defeat
item.description:
Al Ahly announced early on Tuesday they had parted ways with Moroccan coach Hussein Amouta and his staff after a 2-0 defeat to Pyramids in the ninth round of the Premier League. The club said Yassin Mansour and Sayed Abdel Hafeez, who oversee football affairs, will put forward candidates within hours. Al Ahly dropped to third on 20 points, with Pyramids top on 27.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/24/x/7630225 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2534824 · Shorouk News https://www.shorouknews.com/news/view.aspx?cdate=24112026&id=4b76a007-8be1-4e7d-ab78-3c0611b1d240 · Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7192298

item.title: Zamalek beat El Gouna 2-1 to move up to second
item.description:
Zamalek beat El Gouna 2-1 on Monday evening in the ninth round of the Egyptian Premier League, moving up to second place on 22 points. Palestinian forward Oday Dabbagh opened the scoring in the 10th minute, a goal that refereeing analyst Yasser Abdel Raouf said should have been ruled offside.
Sources: Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7192279 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2534821

item.title: Egypt concludes first International Social Protection Forum in New Capital
item.description:
The first International Social Protection Forum, Himaya 2026, concludes on Tuesday in the New Capital after Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly opened it under the patronage of President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi with the theme Social Protection in a Changing World. According to the State Information Service, Takaful and Karama beneficiaries have risen to 4.7 million families, and the social registry covers 13 million families.
Sources: Youm7 (State Information Service) https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/24/x/7629177 · Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7192071

item.title: Dollar steady at EGP54.39 selling at National Bank of Egypt
item.description:
The dollar held steady against the pound in early trading on Tuesday, at about EGP54.29 buying and EGP54.39 selling at the National Bank of Egypt and Banque Misr. The Central Bank of Egypt quoted EGP54.44 selling, close to Monday’s closing level.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/24/x/7629786 · Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7192261

item.title: 21-carat gold steady near EGP5,700 in early trading
item.description:
Gold prices in Egypt held steady in early trading on Tuesday, with the most traded 21-carat gram at EGP5,700 to EGP5,715 and the gold pound at about EGP45,720. The metal kept Monday’s gains of about EGP175 as the global ounce stayed above $3,600.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/24/x/7629945 · Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7192258

item.title: Asian stocks surge, Taiwan up 9.1% after Huang’s return
item.description:
Asian markets surged in early trading on Tuesday after Wall Street rebounded on Nvidia’s reinstatement of Jensen Huang as chief executive. Taiwan’s Taiex jumped 9.1% to 40,151.84 and the Nikkei rose about 5%. South Korea’s KOSPI climbed 5.68% to 4,976.15 in the first minutes, and the exchange suspended program trading for five minutes.
Sources: Gulf News (AFP) https://gulfnews.com/business/markets/nvidia-rally-sends-asian-stocks-soaring-wall-street-gains-1-trillion-1.500758656 · Yonhap https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261124001651320?section=economy-finance/economy

item.title: US investigates cyberattacks targeting about 50 ships
item.description:
The United States is investigating whether Iran was behind cyberattacks targeting as many as 50 vessels carrying oil, liquefied petroleum gas and chemicals, according to The Wall Street Journal. The paper said attackers exploited vulnerabilities in routers used by shipping companies, that Russia is also a suspect, and that investigators have not yet established Iranian responsibility.
Sources: Gulf News (AFP) https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/trump-threatens-to-sink-iranian-vessels-as-us-strikes-oil-tanker-ghalibaf-calls-for-lasting-security-1.500757421 · Cairo 24 (WSJ) https://www.cairo24.com/2534830

item.title: Guterres calls for global AI risk framework within a year
item.description:
UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres on Monday called on member states to develop within the next year a multilateral framework for managing artificial intelligence risks, backed by independent and credible oversight. He spoke at the close of the Bridgetown Special Summit on AI Safety in Barbados, weeks before his term ends in December.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/un-chief-calls-for-world-to-agree-on-ai-oversight-within-a-year · UN News https://news.un.org/en/story/2026/11/1168861

item.title: Trump directs Justice Department to expedite federal executions
item.description:
US President Donald Trump on Monday signed a presidential directive at the Justice Department instructing the attorney general to expedite federal executions. The directive also seeks the death penalty in cases involving the murder of children, rape and killings linked to human trafficking. Trump attacked California Governor Gavin Newsom for commuting death sentences in his state.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/trump-calls-to-expedite-us-federal-executions-blasts-gavin-newsom · Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7192304

item.title: Democrats win largest House majority since 1992
item.description:
The Democratic Party has raised its majority in the US House of Representatives to 258 of 435 seats, the largest for either party since 1992, after Chuck Hubbard defeated Republican Representative Virginia Foxx in North Carolina. Democrats hold a 56-seat Senate majority out of 100, four House races remain uncalled, and the new Congress is sworn in on 3 January.
Sources: Kuwait Times (AFP) https://kuwaittimes.com/article/54215/top-stories/democrats-win-largest-us-house-majority-since-1992/ · Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/what-could-democrats-do-with-their-expanding-congressional-majority

item.title: Russian warplanes enter South Korea’s air defence zone
item.description:
Several Russian warplanes briefly entered South Korea’s air defence identification zone over the East Sea early on Tuesday, prompting Seoul to scramble fighter jets and issue an alert for Ulleung Island that was lifted after three minutes. The Joint Chiefs of Staff said the planes did not violate the country’s airspace, correcting an earlier alert that identified them as North Korean.
Sources: Yonhap https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261124002251315?section=national/defense · Cairo 24 (Reuters) https://www.cairo24.com/2534822
